title: Senior capital enablement is priced by the capital's distance from the Agent, and the ratios cap total leverage near 3.6x own capital
content:
A.3.2.2.2.2.1 sets the External Per Internal ratio at **1.00**: an Agent may source external junior capital only up to the amount of its own. A.3.2.2.2.2.2 then sets Senior Per Junior ratios that differ by the *provenance* of the junior capital:

- Internal Junior Risk Capital — **1.00**
- EPI-acquired Prime External JRC (rented from another Prime) — **0.75**
- EPI-acquired Tokenized External JRC (retail sUSDS deposits) — **0.50**
- SPJ-acquired External JRC — **zero**

The ordering is a statement about the reliability of loss absorption. The Agent's own capital, held in its own treasury under its own root governance, enables senior capital one-for-one. Capital designated by a peer Prime under an Ecosystem Accord — which never leaves the lender's treasury (A.3.2.1.2.2.1.1.2) — enables three quarters as much. Anonymous tokenized capital from external depositors enables half. Nominal amounts are equal; enablement power is not.

The worked example makes the aggregate effect concrete: 20m internal, 10m Prime-external and 10m tokenized junior capital enables 32.5m of senior capital. Chaining the constraints from 20m of own capital gives at most 20m of EPI-sourced external junior (EPI = 1.00), and a junior pool weighted at roughly 32.5m of senior enablement — a total Risk Capital figure in the low 70m range from 20m of genuinely own money, or about 3.6x.

That multiple is the framework's real answer to "how levered may a Prime Agent be," and it is assembled from three separate ratios rather than stated anywhere as a single number. Anyone auditing the framework's conservatism has to derive it, which is a legibility cost worth noting: a change to any one of the four SPJ values silently moves system-wide leverage.
description: SPJ is 1.00 for internal junior capital, 0.75 for capital rented from another Prime, 0.50 for tokenized retail capital and 0 for SPJ-sourced capital; EPI is 1.00.
